title: Alembic post-D32 compatibility removal cleanup
purpose: Remove preserved compatibility paths from D29/D32 by migrating current consumers to canonical post-D32 interfaces, then deleting old aliases/fallbacks/parsers and tightening drift gates.
globalUserDecisions: Continue compatibility deletion and cleanup after D32.
Use only new interfaces or contracts for cross-repository integration.
Keep integration clean without split paths or downgrade behavior.
Preserve full functionality while removing compatibility paths.
claimRules: Claim at most one demand at a time.
CR0 must run before product cleanup packages.
Delete only after current consumers are migrated and replacement validation passes.
If external consumer compatibility is ambiguous, mark a release/breaking-change decision instead of deleting silently.
Final CR7 acceptance must review raw evidence, not target summaries.

items.title: Compatibility Removal Readiness Scan
items.goal: Build the exact deletion readiness matrix from D29/D32 and current code before dispatching product cleanup.
items.completionDefinition: Every preserved compatibility candidate has current consumer scan, replacement path, dispatch owner, validation command, delete-ready status, and stop condition.

initialTaskPackages.summary: Scan preserved compatibility candidates and build product dispatch matrix.
initialTaskPackages.targetSummary: Review D29/D32 preserved compatibility, scan current code, and create exact CR1-CR7 dispatch matrix.

items.title: Core ProjectScope Legacy Path Removal
items.goal: Move all current consumers to canonical ProjectScope identifiers and remove cross-repo reliance on legacyPath/byLegacyPath ambiguity compatibility.
items.completionDefinition: Product consumers use projectScopeId/qualifiedPath, no active product source imports or reads legacy path compatibility, Core removes or quarantines legacy lookup from public paths, and representative builds/tests/replay pass.

items.title: Alembic Runtime Alias Removal
items.goal: Remove public project runtime request aliases and whole-result compatibility after current consumers use canonical action contracts.
items.completionDefinition: Canonical waitUntilReadyMs/action projection paths are the only internal product consumers; legacy waitMs public alias is deleted or explicitly blocked as external release decision; route tests and runtime smoke pass.

items.title: Dashboard Compatibility Fallback Removal
items.goal: Replace Dashboard legacy labels, aliases, and guessing fallbacks with canonical provider/capability/problem fields.
items.completionDefinition: Dashboard adapters consume canonical provider/capability fields; compatibility fallback policies are deleted or test-only; UI states and contract replay pass.

items.title: Plugin Legacy Input And Envelope Removal
items.goal: Remove public legacy input/envelope compatibility from MCP tool paths after host inputs and tool outputs use canonical contracts.
items.completionDefinition: Public MCP tools require canonical inputSource and clean per-tool structuredContent; legacy envelope fields are absent from public parsing/output; real MCP probes pass.

items.title: Agent Public Compatibility Semantics Removal
items.goal: Ensure Agent public results expose only canonical contract semantics while provider-private quirks stay private.
items.completionDefinition: Public Agent interfaces do not expose legacy compatibility semantics, DeepSeek/provider quirks are private adapter behavior only when needed, and branch fixtures/tests pass.

items.title: Compatibility Drift Gate Tightening
items.goal: Tighten drift gates so removed compatibility fields and aliases cannot reappear in public paths.
items.completionDefinition: D30 drift gate command set is updated or extended to fail on removed public compatibility fields, while provider-private/internal shims remain allowed only in named private contexts.

items.title: Compatibility Removal Runtime Acceptance And Archive
items.goal: Validate runtime/MCP/Dashboard behavior after compatibility removal and archive final cleanup.
items.completionDefinition: Runtime smoke, MCP probes, Dashboard contract/UI evidence, consumer replay, import scans, and Wakeflow verification pass; final archive states deleted, private-only, blocked, and release-decision paths.
